name: @pgfsm/proto-codegen-plugins
description: The buf CLI plus the protoc-gen-* binaries local.buf.gen.yaml and hybrid.buf.gen.yaml invoke as `local:` plugins for TypeScript output. Not a runtime dependency of any app -- only used to run `npm run generate:local` / `npm run generate:remote` / `npm run generate:hybrid` in this package. Generated output is exposed to TS consumers via deno.json's `exports`, not this file.

scripts.generate:local:docker: docker build -t fsm-proto-codegen-local . && docker run --rm -v "$PWD:/workspace" fsm-proto-codegen-local
